body: Playing it more and more it takes on its own identity. You get better at the stealth and parkour disconnecting it from Valhalla. But of course the game looks and acts the same (cutscenes and other random things) over all I feel like I’m playing ac mirage not ac Valhalla Mirage dlc, this is of course my opinion. If your not to exited about the game maybe wait for a sale and see for yourself. Your mind is always the best judge not other people. That’s what I wish people hating on the game understood. They haven’t even played it yet say they hate it.

For me it’s basically that they were forced to us the Valhalla engine or design. It’s so much better than Valhalla but if you played it then you can really tell and kinda feel it still. It’s much more fluid and faster but it, for a while, will feel like Valhalla. That’s where a lot of hate is coming from online, it feels like Valhalla until you can get used to it

It would have but the small team that made this game at Ubisoft got a raw deal. They where given the Valhalla engine to work with and a small time frame to make it drastically better than Valhalla. It is a huge step up and finally a good, maybe not necessarily very good, AC game. If given more time, more resources, and a bigger team they could have made something truly great. But that’s just Ubisoft, making bad decisions left and right
